entities.summary: Ilinden Uprising, a transformative movement in North Macedonia (1893–1908). Emerged from Internal Macedonian Revolution and Kruševo Republic. Catalyzed IMRO launches the Ilinden Uprising; Kruševo Republic proclaimed and Goce Delčev killed before the uprising.
